# HUAWEI Consumer

> HUAWEI's global consumer electronics platform featuring flagship smartphones, wearables, laptops, and audio devices integrated with HUAWEI Mobile Services.

HUAWEI Consumer is the official destination for purchasing and learning about HUAWEI's consumer products including the Mate series smartphones, GT series smartwatches, MateBook laptops, and FreeBuds audio devices. The site also provides access to HUAWEI's ecosystem services, community forums, and comprehensive support resources.

## Key Topics

- HUAWEI Mate 80 Pro
- HUAWEI WATCH GT 6 Pro
- HUAWEI Mobile Services

- Wearables

- Product features
- Design

- AppGallery

## Flagship Products

- [HUAWEI Mate 80 Pro](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/phones/mate80-pro): HUAWEI Mate 80 Pro flagship smartphone with dual space rings and true-color camera system.
- [HUAWEI WATCH Ultimate 2](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/wearables/watch-ultimate-2): HUAWEI WATCH Ultimate 2 premium smartwatch with diving, golf, and underwater communication.
- [HUAWEI MateBook GT 14](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/laptops/matebook-gt-14): HUAWEI MateBook GT 14 laptop with OLED display, turbo power, and innovative cooling system.

## Wearables & Smartwatches

- [HUAWEI WATCH GT 6 Pro](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/wearables/watch-gt6-pro): HUAWEI WATCH GT 6 Pro smartwatch with 21-day battery and outdoor sports tracking.
- [HUAWEI WATCH GT Runner 2](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/wearables/watch-gt-runner-2): HUAWEI WATCH GT Runner 2 product page featuring ultra-precision positioning and marathon mode.
- [HUAWEI Band 11 Pro](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/wearables/band11-pro): HUAWEI Band 11 Pro smartwatch with GNSS positioning, sleep tracking, and health monitoring.

## Audio Devices

- [HUAWEI FreeBuds Pro 5](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/headphones/freebuds-pro-5): HUAWEI FreeBuds Pro 5 wireless earbuds with lossless audio and dual-driver ANC.
- [HUAWEI FreeClip 2](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/headphones/freeclip2): HUAWEI FreeClip 2 open-ear wireless earbuds with C-bridge design and comfort fit.

## HUAWEI Ecosystem & Services

- [HUAWEI Global](https://consumer.huawei.com/en): HUAWEI homepage showcasing latest smartphones, wearables, PCs, tablets, and audio devices.
- [HUAWEI Mobile Services](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/mobileservices): HUAWEI Mobile Services ecosystem including AppGallery, Cloud, Music, Video, and Gaming.

## Support & Community

- [HUAWEI Support](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support): HUAWEI support center offering FAQs, troubleshooting, warranty, and service locator.
- [HUAWEI Community](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/community): Official HUAWEI community hub for user forums, discussions, and product news.
